task.description:
Root cause: TEST-RUNNER retry 5 (commit 5eddb97b) reported that all 27 PLC tests fail at migration harness with:
  [MIGRATION_DEBUG] simpleQuery failed: err=QueryFailed
  schema=tenant_default file=1157_prm09_solution_pack_update.sql
  Underlying psql error: column "tenant_id" does not exist

Root cause analysis:
- src/db/migrations.zig::migrationScope matches '-- scope: public' case-sensitively via std.mem.indexOf
- migrations/1157_prm09_solution_pack_update.sql line 5 carries '-- Scope: public.' (capital S)
- migrations/1156_prm06_promotion_assertion_runs.sql line 6 also has '-- Scope: tenant_only.' (capital S)
- These files are silently classified as 'all_schemas' and run on tenant_default, where their ALTER TABLE … ADD COLUMN tenant_id fails because the tenant-side table has no tenant_id column

Fix:
1. Edit migrations/1157_prm09_solution_pack_update.sql: change '-- Scope: public.' to '-- scope: public.' on line 5
2. Edit migrations/1156_prm06_promotion_assertion_runs.sql: change '-- Scope: tenant_only.' to '-- scope: tenant_only.' on line 6
3. Verify no other migrations have '-- Scope:' (capital S) header — grep and audit
4. Verify migrationScope now classifies them correctly: zig build migrate-test (or direct psql test)
5. Commit and push
6. Update handoff to COMPLETED with PASS

Don't run zig build test-integration-plc — TEST-RUNNER will retry next.
